mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals growing consumer demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 600.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% YoY, it signals a disinflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) are falling, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 0.3pp in 3 months and PAYEMS < 0 in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 0.3pp and PAYEMS < 0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY < 2% and INDPRO YoY < 0%.
